config.notes: SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-10: CQL - Arithmetic Operators Part 1. Test these items: Abs, Add, Ceiling, Divide, Floor, Exp, HighBoundary, Log, Ln, LowBoundary. EXPLORER independently reran the chunk from source/tests without inspecting archived prior workflow outputs. Native-loaded C++ DuckDB registration, C++-only/browser extension surface where available, and forced Python fallback registration were all exercised.

issues.summary: Public HighBoundary/LowBoundary helper surfaces diverged between C++ and Python fallback for exponent numeric text, invalid temporal strings, and DateTime timezone suffixes.
issues.resolution: Python fallback and native C++ boundary helpers now validate temporal components and timezone offsets, normalize exponent numeric text for C++-only/browser direct calls, and preserve DateTime timezone suffixes after precision filling.

issues.summary: C++-only dateAddQuantity accepted invalid Date/DateTime and null Quantity values, and failed to preserve fractional day/week arithmetic for DateTime precision.
issues.resolution: Native DateTime parsing now rejects invalid dates and impossible timezone offsets; dateAddQuantity/dateSubtractQuantity return NULL for invalid or empty quantities; day/week quantity math uses millisecond arithmetic for hour-or-finer DateTime inputs.

issues.summary: Translated Quantity/scalar multiply and divide with NULL operands emitted Quantity JSON containing a null value instead of SQL NULL.
issues.resolution: Scaled Quantity construction now guards quantity value, scalar value, and division-by-zero before building JSON, returning SQL NULL for invalid scalar arithmetic.

issues.summary: Accepted translator paths for one-argument Log and Date +/- Integer lowered to binder-failing SQL instead of executable helper calls.
issues.resolution: One-argument Log now routes through mathLn; Date/DateTime +/- Integer lowers through dateAddQuantity/dateSubtractQuantity with a year Quantity.
